text:
Carmen D.: Thanks for the all-hands — dropping a short thread to lock down GTM/partner action items.
Noah B.: Nice, quick answers: 1) Renewal triage window = next 75 days, prioritize accounts > $25k ARR or flagged "exec_risk". 2) Partner-led vs self-serve: partner-led for named ISV/referral partners, self-serve stays for trial conversions. 3) Co-sell credits = we report influenced pipeline + attributed wins separately.
Sofia K.: Ops: which CRM saved view and minimal fields should sales pull for the renewal slide?
ops-bot: Use saved view `renewals_triage_75`. Minimal fields: account_name, ARR, renewal_date, exec_owner, product_health_flag, partner_referral. Nightly export pushed to /ops/renewals/renewals-triage.csv. Reminder set.
Avery L.: For routing — if a partner-originated opp grows past $150k but partner still engaged, keep partner-managed during Q3 pilot; set `joint_owner=true` in CRM if AE needs field support.
Carmen D.: Measurement clarification: marketing wants weekly influenced pipeline count; revops needs attributed closed-won for comp. Q3 targets: +18% influenced, 5 attributed partner-sourced closes.
Noah B.: PS/SE ask: will partner PoCs get prioritized? last quarter some slipped.
Sofia K.: PS will reserve triage capacity for partner-backed PoCs where partner commits resources; SLA doc will be posted by Fri.
Carmen D.: A few operational asks: 1) Ops -> publish the minimal CSV template + sample renewal slide by Mon 10:00 PT. 2) Partnerships -> post co-sell enablement checklist and pilot AE list by Wed. 3) RevOps -> confirm attribution cutoffs for comp by end of week. 4) Sales -> tag #partners on partner introductions and set `partner_source` on close.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: upload template and sample slide by Mon 10:00 PT.
Noah B.: I'll fold this into the leadership digest and flag any blockers.
Avery L.: Will prep at-risk accounts and ping ops once list ready.
Carmen D.: Thanks all  replying here if you want to add anything before I send summary to execs.
